enter-ordered.why: Typora writes the new item with the number before it (1., 1.); Aurink counts on (2.). Both show 1, 2.

bs-quote-second-line.why:
Typora merges the paragraphs and leaves a stray '>' line after them ('> abcd
>'); Aurink merges without it ('> abcd').

select-all-delete.why: Typora leaves an empty item '- ' after deleting everything; Aurink leaves the document empty.

enter-after-image.why: Typora's Ctrl+End stops before a lone image; not a key behaviour to copy.

enter-in-link.why: Typora's Ctrl+Home then Right does not enter a link at the start of the document; not a key behaviour to copy.

shift-enter-table.why:
Typora writes
, Aurink
; the same line break.
